### Table reference {#sec-schema-detail}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### meta

31 rows = 31 events, `R2026002`–`R2026556`.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tournamentId` | text | PK by convention |
| `tournamentStatus` | text | all `COMPLETED` |
| `timezone` | text | |
| `formatType` | text | all `STROKE_PLAY` |
| `source_file` | text | leaderboard JSON this import came from |
| `n_shots` | int | |
| `has_radar` | int | 0 for `R2026522` and `R2026541` only |
| `has_putt_paths` | int | 0 for the same two |
| `imported_at` | text | all `2026-09-06` |

### courses

35 rows / 31 events: `R2026002` has 3 courses; `R2026004` and `R2026005` have 2.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | 3-char course id, as embedded in image URLs |
| `courseName` | text | |
| `courseCode` | text | 2-letter, **not** unique across tournaments |
| `scoringLevel` | text | `TOURCAST` or `STATS` |
| `hostCourse` | int | 1 = the venue that has 3-D assets |
| `tournamentId` | text | → `meta.tournamentId` |

### players

475 distinct people, 3,535 event-entries. 55 columns total, mostly UI chrome.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | stable across events |
| `tournamentId` | text | → `meta.tournamentId` |
| `leaderboardSortOrder` | int | 0 = winner |
| `position` | text | `1`, `T2`, `CUT` |
| `total` | text | score to par, stored as TEXT |
| `totalSort` | int | |
| `score` | text | today, to par |
| `thru` | text | |
| `totalStrokes` | text | |
| `courseId` | text | → `courses.id` |
| `groupNumber` | int | |
| `currentRound` | int | |
| `backNine` | int | |
| `roundStatus` | text | |
| `playerState` | text | |
| *name fields* | text | `firstName` `lastName` `displayName` `shortName` `country` `countryFlag` `amateur` |
| *leaderboard chrome* | text | `movement` `ranking` `projected` `sponsorLogo` `tooltip` — UI only |
| *denorm meta* | text | `tournamentStatus` `timezone` `formatType` `source_file` |

### rounds

14,048 rows.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | player id → `players.id` |
| `displayName` | text | |
| `round_num` | int | 1–4 |
| `round_score` | text | `-` if not played |
| `tournamentId` | text | → `meta.tournamentId` |

### holes

204,624 rows.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tournamentId` | text | → `meta.tournamentId` |
| `playerId` | text | → `players.id` |
| `round` | int | |
| `holeNumber` | int | 1–18 |
| `par` | int | |
| `yardage` | int | |
| `status` | text | `PAR` `BIRDIE` `BOGEY` `DOUBLE_BOGEY` `EAGLE` |
| `score` | text | TEXT, not int |
| `rank` | text | TEXT, not int |
| `pin_svx` | real | **survey feet — populated on all rows. Use this** |
| `pin_svy` | real | survey feet |
| `pin_svz` | real | survey feet — a real elevation |
| `pin_x` | int | green image 0–1; `-1` = missing. Legacy |
| `pin_y` | int | green image 0–1; `-1` = missing. Legacy |
| `pin_z` | int | always `-1`, never an elevation |
| `tee_x` | int | hole image 0–1; approx `-10` = missing |
| `tee_y` | int | hole image 0–1; approx `-10` = missing |
| `tee_z` | int | always `-1` |
| `fairway_x` | real | survey feet, not normalized; `0` = missing on 46,762 rows |
| `fairway_y` | real | survey feet |
| `fairway_z` | real | |
| `hole_image_url` | text | |
| `green_image_url` | text | encodes season + event + 3-digit course id + hole |
| *denorm player* | text | `firstName` `lastName` `displayName` `shortName` `country` `countryFlag` `amateur` `total` `totalSort` `thru` |

### shots

801,101 rows, 65 columns.

**Keys and identity**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tournamentId` | text | → `meta.tournamentId` |
| `playerId` | text | → `players.id` |
| `round` | int | |
| `hole_num` | int | note: `hole_num`, **not** `holeNumber` |
| `stroke_num` | int | note: `stroke_num`, **not** `strokeNumber` |

**Classification and outcome**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shot_type` | text | `STROKE` 790,523 / `DROP` 6,657 / `PENALTY` 3,921 — never `Putt` |
| `is_final` | int | 1 if this stroke holed out |
| `shot_distance` | text | **string**, e.g. `326 yds` or `24 ft 1 in`. Distance *moved*, not distance to hole |
| `distance_to_hole` | text | same string formats; empty when holed |
| `from_loc` | text | |
| `to_loc` | text | |
| `from_loc_code` | text | `OGR` = on green = a putt. 327,360 rows |
| `to_loc_code` | text | |
| `play_by_play` | text | |
| `shot_label` | text | |
| `markerText` | text | |
| `video_id` | text | |
| `showMarker` | int | |
| `groupShowMarker` | int | |

**Coordinates — survey feet (use these)**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `from_svx` | real | **survey feet.** `-1` = missing on 34,601 rows, almost all at the non-host courses of `R2026002` and `R2026004` |
| `from_svy` | real | survey feet |
| `from_svz` | real | survey feet — a real elevation |
| `to_svx` | real | survey feet |
| `to_svy` | real | |
| `to_svz` | real | |

**Coordinates — green, enhanced**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `green_from_ex` | real | the API `enhancedX` — normalized green image, may fall outside 0–1 |
| `green_from_ey` | real | |
| `green_to_ex` | real | |
| `green_to_ey` | real | |

**Coordinates — legacy (prefer the survey columns above)**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `from_x` | real | hole image 0–1; `-1` = missing |
| `from_y` | real | |
| `from_z` | real | always `-1.0` |
| `to_x` | real | hole image 0–1 |
| `to_y` | real | |
| `to_z` | real | always `-1.0` |
| `green_from_x` | real | green image 0–1; approx `-10` = missing on 134,571 rows |
| `green_from_y` | real | |
| `green_to_x` | real | |
| `green_to_y` | real | |

**Putting**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `putt_lip_out` | int | |
| `putt_distance_inches` | real | the reliable putt length |
| `putt_reconstruction` | text | `camera` / `simulation` / `NULL` — confounded with outcome |

| `radar_apex_side` | real | |
| `radar_launch_spin` | real | |
| `radar_spin_axis` | real | |

| `radar_launch_angle_h` | real | |
| `radar_flight_time` | real | |

**Denormalized**

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|

### putt_paths

4,148,494 rows across 29 events — missing `R2026522` and `R2026541`.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tournamentId` | text | → `meta.tournamentId` |
| `playerId` | text | → `players.id` |
| `round` | int | |
| `holeNumber` | int | → `shots.hole_num` |
| `strokeNumber` | int | → `shots.stroke_num` |
| `x` | real | survey feet |
| `y` | real | survey feet |
| `z` | real | survey feet |
| `secondsSinceStart` | real | **`ORDER BY` this — rows are not stored in order** |

### trajectories

306,264 rows across 29 events.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tournamentId` | text | → `meta.tournamentId` |
| `playerId` | text | → `players.id` |
| `round` | int | |
| `holeNumber` | int | → `shots.hole_num` |
| `strokeNumber` | int | → `shots.stroke_num` |
| `kind` | text | always `Flight` |
| `type` | text | `Incoming` 171,511 / `Broadcast` 134,753 |
| `xFit` | text | JSON poly coefficients, **ascending** powers of t |
| `yFit` | text | JSON |
| `zFit` | text | JSON |
| `spinRateFit` | text | JSON |
| `timeInterval` | text | JSON `start,end` seconds |
| `validTimeInterval` | text | JSON |
| `measuredTimeInterval` | text | JSON |
| `__typename` | text | GraphQL residue |

### trajectories_norm_v1 / v2

182,744 rows each. `v2` has the same schema as `v1`, and `carry` is identical
to `v1` on every joined row.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *key cols* | text | `tournamentId` `playerId` `round` `holeNumber` `strokeNumber` |
| `valid` | int | 1 for every row |
| `yFit` | text | JSON lateral. **There is no `xFit`** — normalization removed that axis |
| `zFit` | text | JSON vertical |
| `timeInterval` | text | JSON |
| `validTimeInterval` | text | JSON |
| `carry` | real | |
| `carrySide` | real | |
| `curve` | real | |
| `maxHeight` | real | |
| `spinAxis` | real | |
| `windVelocity` | text | JSON |
